tier1.text: Each internal thoracic vein drains blood from the front of the chest wall. This vein travels with the internal thoracic artery and also drains the breast. Each internal thoracic vein then empties into a brachiocephalic vein, which drains the upper chest.

quotes.quote: brachiocephalic vein: one of a pair of veins that form from a fusion of the external and internal jugular veins and the subclavian vein; subclavian, external and internal jugulars, vertebral, and internal thoracic veins lead to it; drains the upper thoracic region
